scope: Proposed experiments and acceptance criteria; no new artwork approved.

individualJudgments.B: null / not yet scored; preserve independent/visual-b.json.

challenges.claim: B: conspicuous double antenna contour at header scale.
challenges.assessment: Real boundary difference; not yet a demonstrated application failure. character.js:140–148 places a 16-unit edge behind a 10-unit ink stroke, leaving roughly three units per side, at .85 night opacity (234). identity.png visibly shows the rim, but its repaired 96/128/160px stems and readme-390-night.png remain coherent. Compare quieter alternatives without sacrificing that connection.

challenges.claim: B: Grateful, Shy and Worried need hand/ruff separation.
challenges.assessment: Accept the density observation; reject automatic separation. poses.png shows Worried already gains a clear lowered mitten while Grateful retains deliberate contact. character.js:130–135,189–194 explains the similarly weighted outlines. all-24.png supports a scrutiny target, not failed intention recognition. Assess the gesture before moving either hand.

challenges.claim: B: refinements must improve a specific reading problem; contour precedes material.
challenges.assessment: Broaden the adoption criterion. The inspected raster has softly modelled cream and wing volume; current SVG uses simple gradients (90–96) and regular contours. A reversible material study may increase gentle appeal without repairing a defect. Require a named visible benefit and no regression; neither added texture nor simplification earns automatic credit.

agreements: Preserve tiny anatomy, unequal paddles, four layered marked wings, shared geometry/poses and intact raster masters.
Keep successful antenna continuity and pose refinements as the comparison baseline.
No gratuitous grain, fur marks, broad glow or arbitrary contour simplification.
differences: A gives an explicitly scoped 8.4; B withholds a score. Neither position changes through plan agreement.
B prioritizes contour/overlap; A additionally wants a controlled material study. Both can be evaluated without production changes.

prioritizedExperiments.experiment: Compare baseline, reduced whole-character rim, and a slightly quieter local antenna edge separately.
prioritizedExperiments.benefit: Crisper night articulation and a less conspicuous large-size rim while preserving attached stems.

prioritizedExperiments.experiment: Compare one deliberate contact/separation treatment for Grateful, Shy and Worried; include unchanged Thinking as a control.
prioritizedExperiments.benefit: Meaningful mitten gesture reads before necklace-like line density, without losing clasped tenderness.

prioritizedExperiments.experiment: Compare a restrained cream/forewing tonal-falloff variant at matched visible height; retain contours and no added texture.
prioritizedExperiments.benefit: Softer, more tactile appeal while preserving the face-first hierarchy.

acceptanceCriteria: Inspect original-size 32/48/64px avatars, 96/128/160px full figures and actual header placements in both themes; enlarge only to diagnose.
Keep geometry and numeric poses identical across themes; local paint/stroke changes may alter visible boundaries and must be acknowledged.
Name the visible clarity or appeal gain against baseline; reject variants with disconnected antennae, muddy hands, glossy cream or distracting halos.
Review matched poses plus continuous motion for any adopted pose or rendering change; preserve editable variants, evidence and raster originals.
Fresh independent A/B judgment is required for adoption. No nine, human recognition or final-art approval follows from this plan.
remainingObjections: No substantive A objection to this scoped experiment plan. B confirmation remains outstanding; this is not yet joint agreement.
